## Context / Problem
The two nginx files contain repeated or historical comments identified by the audit and revalidated on current `origin/main`. Shortening them must preserve security-sensitive proxy rationale.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve nginx directives byte-for-byte and retain the minimum current rationale needed by operators.

## Scope
- `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` — Preserve the committed safe seed, generated live include, host-nginx glob consumer, and default upstream.
- `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` — Preserve TLS/HSTS, switchable MCP upstream, literal forwarded scheme, op-cert guard, SSE buffering/timeouts, RFC 9728 metadata, and Gerrit proxy behavior. Preserve explicitly: `/mcp` and `/mcp/` both map to app `/mcp` to avoid Starlette's absolute 307 and bearer downgrade; `proxy_redirect default` precedes explicit upgrade rules because any explicit rule disables the implicit default; Gerrit uses pathless `proxy_pass` with no rewrite so encoded `%2F` survives. All explanatory comments in the file are in scope.

Consumers are nginx, the upstream materializer, MCP/Gerrit clients, operators, and security review.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] DD `preserve-nginx-data` exits 0.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and named consumer has a leaf-linked TSV row with full before/final block citations.
- [ ] Every Scope/consumer row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every required TSV row has a non-empty `reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every `reviewer_session` identifies a reviewer who did not author the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited comment block has one TSV row satisfying `before_words > after_words`.
- [ ] Every edited-block row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] DD `nginx-consumer-contracts` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `diff-integrity` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `repository-gates` exits 0.

## Verification
Run the recorded comment-only guard, focused MCP/op-cert infrastructure tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint.
